keyEvents.text: Goal! Bristol City 0, Norwich City 1. Paris Maghoma (Norwich City) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sam Field.
Substitution, Bristol City. Jed Wallace replaces Cameron Pring.
Second Half begins Bristol City 0, Norwich City 1.
Goal! Bristol City 0, Norwich City 2. Harry Darling (Norwich City) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner following a corner.
Goal! Bristol City 0, Norwich City 3. Andre Brooks (Norwich City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Norwich City. Darlin Yongwa replaces Ben Chrisene.
Substitution, Bristol City. Tomi Horvat replaces Jason Knight.
Substitution, Bristol City. Dom Ballard replaces Lorent Tolaj.
Substitution, Norwich City. Lucien Mahovo replaces Andre Brooks.
Substitution, Norwich City. Jovon Makama replaces Paris Maghoma.
Substitution, Bristol City. Brian De Keersmaecker replaces Joe Williams.
Goal! Bristol City 0, Norwich City 4. Jovon Makama (Norwich City) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Anthony Musaba.
Substitution, Bristol City. Elijah Adebayo replaces Scott Twine.
Substitution, Norwich City. Oscar Schwartau replaces Anthony Musaba.
Substitution, Norwich City. Kenny McLean replaces Sam Field.
Goal! Bristol City 0, Norwich City 5. Mathias Kvistgaarden (Norwich City) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
